rationale: Operator chose b (2026-11-26, full rubric). Problem: enterprise D5 pulls into the SQLite index; rebuildIndex wipes it (rmSync + DELETE). But rebuildIndex already reads through store.list('all') (retrieval/service.ts:31-47), so the wipe loses data only when a sync writes the index directly. Pick: no new index write path; RFC-0053 amendment states a sync writes the backend replica that list() reads, then calls rebuildIndex; the index stays derived (OQ-2). Counter: full rebuild per sync does not scale; survives because the cost appears only with an API embedder (no cache, sqlite-index.ts:68); the fix then is a contentHash embedding cache, not a second write path. Check: whether enterprise uses an API embedder. Provisional: Product (touches OQ-2).
